info.after_add: Staying put suits ordering several things in a row — the cart count in the header confirms each add.
info.alert_message: Links are underlined, and the underline drops away on hover.
info.badge_optional: The short label in the pill. Leave blank to hide it.
info.brand_name_fallback: Leave blank to use the store name from Settings → Store details.
info.bar_media_size: The height of the thumbnail. Its width follows the shape of the image.
info.button_optional: Leave the label or the link blank to hide the button.
info.eyebrow_optional: The small label above the heading. Leave blank to hide it.
info.image_position: Which half of the panel the image takes. Both halves stack on a phone, with the text first.
info.collection_description: The collection description from the admin, trimmed to the first 15 words.
info.collection_price: Worked out from the products in the collection — a single figure when they all cost the same, otherwise the cheapest, shown as a starting price.
info.card_link: Points anywhere — a product, collection, page, or an address off the store. Leave blank for a card that isn't clickable.
info.card_subtitle: The small line under the card title, for example a price or a short description.
info.filter_menu: Shown as pills above the list, with the collection you're on highlighted. Leave blank to hide them.
info.media_fit: Fill crops the image to the shape above. Fit shows all of it, with the image background around the edges.
info.products_per_page: How many products before the list pages. Products with variants add a row each when opened, so a lower number keeps the page light.
info.row_subtitle_source: The short line beside the product title, for example "9 languages" or "Daily meditations".
info.show_sku: Taken from the first available variant, and from each variant in the expanded list.
info.variant_limit: How many variants a row lists when it's opened. Anything past this links out to the product page. Shopify caps this at 50 whatever you pick.
info.section_background_color: Sits behind the panel, edge to edge. Match it to the section above to make the two read as one.
info.subheading: The line under the heading. Leave blank to hide it.
info.featured_collection: Fills any slots the pinned products below don't use, and is where the link points.
info.featured_products: Shown first, in this order. Anything left over is filled from the collection above, skipping products already pinned here.
info.label_fallback: Leave blank to use the collection title.
info.subtitle_metafield: Written as namespace.key, for example custom.subtitle. Products without it just show no subtitle.
info.subtitle_source: The small line between the title and the price.
info.menu_optional: Top-level links show beside the logo on desktop. On smaller screens the whole menu moves into the drawer. Leave blank to hide it.
info.primary_font_weights: The theme loads weights 300, 400, 500, 600 and 700. Any of those a font doesn't ship is synthesised by the browser.
info.logo_fallback: Leave blank to use the logo bundled with the theme.
info.footer_menu: Each top-level menu item becomes a column heading, and its nested items become the links below it.
